name: classy
description: A GitHub service for grading commits and posting feedback.

scripts.cover: TS_NODE_BASEURL=. nyc --reporter text --reporter html --report-dir ./testOutput/coverage yarn run test
scripts.test: yarn build && TS_NODE_BASEURL=. mocha --require=dotenv/config --require tsconfig-paths/register --timeout 10000 --recursive --exit packages/portal/backend/test packages/autotest/test
scripts.test:backend: yarn build && TS_NODE_BASEURL=. mocha --require=dotenv/config --require tsconfig-paths/register --timeout 10000 --recursive --exit packages/portal/backend/test
scripts.test:autotest: yarn build && TS_NODE_BASEURL=. mocha --require=dotenv/config --require tsconfig-paths/register --timeout 10000 --recursive --exit packages/autotest/test
